answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonding each identity to collateral: when k coordinated identities equivocate on the same conflicting statements, correlated penalties grow as O(k²), so splitting stake across aliases does not dilute liability. Detection can trigger an additional exponential multiplier in capital loss across the swarm, amplified by asymmetric depreciation; a ridge of linked evidence, rather than a meadow of isolated claims, guides the beacon to shared control.
